g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: spigot Ø25 g6 x 10 into the plate (U hole); flange 3 x Ø4.5 on PCD 44; spindle end M8 x 15 (collar stop)
Unwind: bore Ø25.2 runs free on the spindle; flange Ø220 x 6 faces the felt brake.
Rewind: no flange, bore Ø12 H8 + M5 set screw on the shaft flat; 2 x 3 slot 40 long to tuck the liner end.
bore Ø25.2 (unwind) / Ø12.2 (rewind) + M5 radial thumb screw; knurled OD
bent 15° at 40; felt 30 x 30 x 5 bonded; drag set by the bend: label roll must not overrun on stop
O-ring pulley at 0-12, bearings in housing 201 at 22-62, hub from 70; 2 flats 0.5; 2 DIN 471 grooves
O-RING PULLEY 306 x 2 (2:1), UHMW Ø45, SECTION

g.text: R2.6 GROOVE, PITCH Ø40, FOR Ø5 PU BELT

svg.text: bore Ø12 H8 + M4 set screw; 1:1 ratio: rewind overspeeds and slips on the round belt
304 shaft Ø10, collar Ø16 against the plate, M8 nut behind (H11); UHMW sleeve Ø20 x 130 bore Ø10.3 free; DIN 471 Ø10
turn flange Ø60 x 8, spindle Ø25 g6, spigot; drill 3 x Ø4.5; tap M8
turn Ø75.2, bore; bond + screw the flange (unwind)
turn, groove R2.6, bore, tap M4
turn shaft, thread M8; turn sleeve
1. Web path order: unwind 301/302 → guide 307 → gap sensor P1-427 → peel plate 401 → tip → liner back under the plate → liner drive 202 with pinch 203 → rewind 305/302.
2. Thread-up card: keep a copy inside the belt guard. The liner end tucks into the rewind hub slot; wind 2 turns by hand before running.
3. Label roll: 3 in core, ≤ 200 OD: about 928 shaker or 694 jar labels per roll.
